subject: Stage mapping, commit definitions, and seller engagement plan
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Amy Liu <amy.liu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage mapping, commit definitions, and seller engagement plan

Team —

Quick heads-up: finance and ops completed the latest round of forecast-category refinements. The goal is to reduce ambiguity between PIPELINE / BEST CASE / COMMIT so we improve forecast predictability for Q2. Summary:

- COMMIT: Signed contracts with a firm deploy timeline (customer legal and procurement approvals done; PM confirmed start-of-integration date).
- BEST CASE: Active negotiation with written plan and stakeholder alignment; no signed contract but high confidence within 30-60 days.
- PIPELINE: Early engagement, scoping, or exploratory conversations; outcomes uncertain.

I attached a short Stage Mapping Guide (stage_mapping_guide_v1.pdf) that maps our existing stage list to the three forecast buckets plus examples and objective evidence needed for escalation. Please review.

Asks:
1) Karthik — can you own the seller training playbook and make a 30-minute calibration for the AE lead cohort next week?
2) Marissa — work with GTM ops to publish the guide to Drive, and create a 1-slide one-pager for sellers that highlights the "objective evidence" checklist for each bucket.
3) Everyone — if you have customer-specific edge cases (e.g., stepwise commissioning, multi-PO scenarios) reply with notes — we'll cover them in the clan call.

I'll send a calendar hold for the calibration once you confirm slots. This is a targeted change: please surface any downstream implications for renewals or recognition.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Global Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: stage_mapping_guide_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage mapping, commit definitions, and seller engagement plan

On Fri, Mar 2, 2028 at 9:12 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick heads-up: finance and ops completed the latest round of forecast-category refinements...

Thanks, Markus — I skimmed the guide and like the objective-evidence approach. A couple quick Qs before I build the training:

- For COMMIT, do we require both a signed contract and a start date in our system-of-record (SFDC activation date), or is a signed contract alone sufficient?
- For deals with multiple SOWs or phased deliveries should we use the highest-confidence tranche as the bucket or split the opportunity into child ops?

Proposed plan from my side:
- 30-minute calibration (live) for AE leads + a 1-hour recorded deep-dive for field sellers.
- One-pager cheat sheet (single slide) + 5 example scenarios (internal playbook).

If you can confirm the COMMIT requirement (signed contract vs contract+activation in SFDC) I’ll finalize the slides and propose two 30-min slots: Wed 3/8 10:00–10:30 or Thu 3/9 14:00–14:30 PT.

Karthik
Sr. Director, Revenue Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Liu <amy.liu@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage mapping, commit definitions, and seller engagement plan

Thanks for the note — attaching a short seller playbook deck (seller_playbook_slide_deck.pptx) that contains the one-pager and the five scenario call-outs. I uploaded the Stage Mapping Guide to Drive and published the link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/stage-mapping-2028 (internal access).

A few operational items I already handled:
- Updated the SFDC field definitions doc so "Activation Date" is required for split-SOW opportunities flagged as COMMIT; otherwise we mark the top-level opp as BEST CASE until activation is scheduled.
- Created an SFDC view for AE leads to surface "COMMIT at-risk" based on missing activation date or missing counterparty PO.

Karthik — Wed 3/8 10:00 PT works for me. I’ll draft the calendar invite and attach the deck; we can record and add to the seller enablement library.

Amy — FYI — this shouldn't change our assessment for your current project; we'll keep you posted if we need any paperwork updates.

Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: seller_playbook_slide_deck.pptx (pptx)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amy Liu <amy.liu@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stage mapping, commit definitions, and seller engagement plan

Perfect — thank you. Quick recap / action items: 

- Karthik: build the 30-min calibration and the recorded deep-dive. Confirm slides by EOD Mon 3/6. (Agenda: definitions, 5 scenario walk-throughs, Q&A, SFDC examples)
- Marissa: send the calendar invite for Wed 3/8 10:00–10:30 PT; attach the seller deck and upload recording to enablement library.
- Ops: enforce Activation Date requirement for COMMIT in SFDC; notify AE leads when Activation Date is missing for deals marked as COMMIT.

Amy — appreciate the quick read. If anything from Acme’s side changes that materially affects the timing we’ll reach out ASAP.

Markus
